name: Sex 'n♪ Panzer
original_name: セックス あ～ん♪ パンツァー
source:
It was 1969.
Strange "living vehicles" appeared out of nowhere and started conquering nations.
Overwhelmed, the people fought back, but we lost out.

Jipang, the "land of the arousing daughter", had few resources
but was succeeded in creating a system where a single person could withstand
huge amounts of firepower. There was one caveat:

The system was perversely limited to use by young girls.

Two candidates were inducted into the system and unleashed on the enemy.

* YOU must press on!
Deal epic destruction as a bullet-spraying missile-launching
Japanese girl against overwhelming oddness, revel in the destruction
in the alternate warscape of future-past 1969!
press onward into enemy territory dealing swaths of glorious destruction!

* And of COURSE (?)..
Should you fail there's assault animations to behold!
Trample into battle with an eye for "winning" AND "losing"
utilizing the Sex Streak System:

- Chain your attacks to produce a massive super-explosion!
- Get assaulted for a sustained length and power up!

Turn the tables from violation to victory. That's the Sex Stream System's merit!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE140315.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
那是1969年。
奇怪的“活体兵器”突然出现，开始征服各个国家。
人们不堪重负奋起反抗，却败下阵来。

被称为“兴奋女儿之国”的次邦资源匮乏，
却成功创造出一种让单人承受巨大火力的系统。
唯一的限制是：

这套系统只能由年轻女孩使用，而且限制极其变态。

两名候选人被纳入系统，向敌人发动攻击。

* 你必须前进！
化身为火力压倒一切、发射子弹与导弹的日本少女，
在架空的未来过去世界1969年中撕裂战场，
向前推进，制造大片辉煌的毁灭！

* 当然（？）……
失败时还能欣赏受袭动画！
抱着“胜利”和“失败”都要赢的念头投入战斗，
运用性爱连击系统：

- 连续发动攻击，制造巨大的超级爆炸！
- 持续遭受侵犯，积蓄力量并强化！

从被侵犯到反败为胜。性爱连锁系统的价值就在于此！

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE140315.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
